free_tier.stated: Unlimited hot storage; 10 TB cold storage included. Additional cold storage €1/TB/month. File cap 300 GB, unlimited file count. Retention = whole subscription period on paid plans.

retention.stated: kept for the whole subscription period on a paid plan ('Retention: 15 days without an account, 30 days on a free account, the whole subscription period on a paid plan')

egress.terms: Verbatim, prices page: 'Premium … Unlimited downloads, with no monthly allowance'. Unlimited downloads = no egress meter at all on the plan. Plus 500 GB/month of CDN credits (Premium GOLD) valued at '€20 for 1 TB, up to €400 for 20 TB'. No per-GB egress fee anywhere on the page.

interface_detail: REST API (api.html), FTP upload (upload-only), rclone native backend, WebDAV via third party
tooling: rclone '1fichier' backend is first-class; REST API documents available_cold_storage / upload_forbidden so quota is machine-readable
chaining: AList/OpenList mount; FTP ingest; API copy of an existing 1fichier link is instant and uses zero bandwidth (documented: 'The copy is instant and uses no bandwidth, neither yours nor ours')
limits_note: 300 GB/file; web upload 500 files and 500 GB per upload / 4 h max; cold/hot classification means a file >60 days undownloaded migrates to the cold bucket; Premium = 1 public IP at a time

identity_cost.detail: registration asks only for an email address, a password and an image confirmation code, with no phone; payment by bank transfer, cryptocurrency, credit card or virtual currency, so no card is needed; paid plans do not renew automatically

reliability_note: Cold-storage overflow is destructive: forum reports say exceeding the cold quota earns a notice that the surplus is erased in 14 days and the account is blocked. Treat cold quota as a hard wall, not a soft one.
confidence_note: the prices page, help page, registration form and API page were read on 2026-10-30; the record states what they say
